customers_say: Customers find the door lock easy to operate with a user-friendly app, and appreciate its impressive build quality and top-tier security features. They like its appearance, noting it looks like a simple door handle, and one customer mentions the mocha finish matches perfectly with their main door. The lock functions well, with one customer noting it works even in dark conditions, and they find it convenient to use. The value for money receives mixed feedback.

reviews.author: KAUSHIK CHATTERJEE
reviews.title: Excellent Premium Digital Lock
reviews.body: Excellent product experience, very good installation and service, product seems to be good. Has so many features.. Installation person was very professional did an excellent job and explained every feature in detail.. App is working seamlessly. Like the product

reviews.author: Raj
reviews.title: Great Look and Excellent Features
reviews.body: Very happy with my purchase! The mocha finish matches perfectly with our main door, and the lock has some great features that make it convenient and easy to use. Overall, very satisfied with the product.

reviews.author: nandish k
reviews.title: No customer care
reviews.body: I bought the lock but have now been informed by native that they don't support installation outside of Bangalore in Karnataka and to make matters worst is native does not have a customer care number to call and discuss. They only have an ai bot to chat and even after emailing them, they have not responded.

reviews.author: abhishek ghadigaonkar
reviews.title: Everyone should buy
reviews.body: Very modern product with modern features. Complete safety, and very easy to use. Loved the product very much. Thank you

reviews.author: shivaditya
reviews.title: Solid smart lock — exactly what I needed
reviews.body: Solid smart lock — exactly what I needed Bought the Native Lock Ultra about three weeks ago and I'm genuinely impressed. The build quality feels premium; heavy-duty and solid, nothing like the flimsy locks I've tried before. The auto-lock feature is my favourite — I no longer have to second-guess whether I locked the door before leaving. The app connectivity is smooth and the fingerprint sensor responds quickly. Battery life seems excellent so far, with no signs of draining fast. The keypad backlight is a nice touch for night use. Overall, great value for the price.
